_doc: Review-staging inbox for the weekly Policy Map scan. The scheduled scan APPENDS candidate milestones here with notification_status='pending'. Nothing here is live until promoted. Teddy: set a candidate's notification_status to 'approved' (or 'rejected'), then run tools/policymap_promote_milestones.py to merge approved items into the live milestones array in both locales and rebuild the .js. The scan never edits the live milestones array and never deletes history.
